I can't trust anyone in this college anymore. Last semester, my girlfriend dumped me right before midterms for someone with a 9+ CGPA and a better summer internship, saying I was 'lacking ambition.' He literally ghosted me after three years, right when midterms started, and now I saw him tagged in some other girl's story at the college fest.
